name: formal-proofs
description: Formally verify the code where a bug costs the most, and keep that verification true to the code as it changes. Includes a Java-only TLA+ checker.

interface.shortDescription: Catch bugs your tests miss with formal checks you can rerun
interface.longDescription: Turns rules such as "retrying a payment must never charge a customer twice" into formal checks, records which code each check covers, and reports when that code changes without a recheck.
